title: Superhost Assessment Results and Same-Day Earnings in Payout Methods On-Request Payouts
content:
The on-request share of fresh earnings, the part of the earnings released to a Payout Methods method on the request date that an on-request payout includes, is set by the host's most recent Superhost assessment on the host's Host Accounts record. Two figures of that assessment are read: its average rating and its completed stays, the completed stays in the assessment's lookback as recorded on it.

## The schedule

- **90 percent** when the most recent Superhost assessment has an average rating of at least 4.90 and completed stays of at least 12;
- **80 percent** when its average rating is at least 4.80 but below 4.90 and its completed stays are at least 12;
- otherwise the share of fresh earnings is not raised by the assessment.

## All combinations

| Average rating on the most recent assessment | Completed stays on it | On-request share of fresh earnings |
|---|---|---|
| 4.90 or higher | 12 or more | 90 percent |
| 4.80 to 4.89 | 12 or more | 80 percent |
| 4.80 or higher | Fewer than 12 | Not raised by the assessment |
| Below 4.80 | Any | Not raised by the assessment |
| No Superhost assessment on record | — | Not raised by the assessment |

## Lines on both sides (hypothetical assessments)

| Average rating | Completed stays | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 4.90 | 12 | 90 percent |
| 4.89 | 40 | 80 percent |
| 4.95 | 11 | Not raised: completed stays below 12 |
| 4.80 | 12 | 80 percent |
| 4.79 | 30 | Not raised |

## Notes

- Only the **most recent** Superhost assessment is read; earlier assessments are not read.
- The assessment's outcome (met or not met) and the host's current tier are not what this schedule reads; it reads the average rating and completed stays recorded on that assessment.
